contributor's fork are blocked from this side:

  the OpenAPI document: 200,000 bp on annotation and 50,000 bp on the

  claim in SKILL.md and tasks.md and point readers at the field.

  orientations, AC never appears, AG-in-span is vacuous because the span is
  snapped) so the "no post-hoc check" claim carries its evidence, and
  document start/end as 4-8 bp BPE token spans with a token_index rather
  than junctions, including in the GFF3 export.

Close two gaps in the skill link contract, and fix what they surface (#258)

- guide/callbacks.html#module-stable_baselines3.common.callbacks
- guide/vec_envs.html#module-stable_baselines3.common.vec_env

Both targets and both anchors were verified against the live docs and the
upstream genindex. The "Official ... Guide" bullet directly above each one
already used the correct `guide/` path, so the two `common/` URLs were
inconsistent within their own files.

Bump metadata.version to "1.2".
